description: This file defines types and constants representing review action buttons and icons for a human resource management system. It exports specific ReviewAction objects for view, edit, and evaluate actions, each detailing the component used and its properties.

methods.name: viewIcon
methods.description: A ReviewAction object representing the 'View' icon button with component 'oxd-icon-button' and props for icon name and title.

methods.name: editIcon
methods.description: A ReviewAction object representing the 'Edit' icon button with component 'oxd-icon-button' and props for icon name and title.

methods.name: evaluateIcon
methods.description: A ReviewAction object representing the 'Evaluate' icon button with component 'oxd-icon-button' and props for icon name and title.
